label: Hero
definition: The opening section of a landing page: main headline + supporting copy + primary call-to-action, usually with a product visual or artwork. Often includes the navigation bar at the very top.

label: Features
definition: Explains what the product does: feature grids, bento layouts, alternating text/visual rows, product UI walkthroughs, capability lists.

label: Value proposition
definition: Benefit-led 'why us' statement with little product detail: a big claim plus a few short benefit points or outcomes. If it mainly shows product UI or a list of capabilities, use feature instead.

label: How it works
definition: A numbered or ordered process: steps 1-2-3, a timeline, a workflow diagram explaining how the product is used.

label: Use cases
definition: Organised by audience: tabs or cards per role, team, industry or use case ('For sales', 'For engineering', 'Fintech', 'Healthcare').

label: Testimonials
definition: Social proof from people: customer quotes, reviews, ratings, tweet walls, case-study cards with a quote.

label: Logo cloud
definition: The section is mainly a row or grid of customer / partner / investor logos ('Trusted by…'). Little other content.

label: Stats
definition: The section is mainly large numbers / metrics with labels (e.g. '10M+ users', '99.9% uptime').

label: Integrations
definition: Shows the tools the product connects to: grids/orbits of third-party app icons, connector diagrams, 'Works with your stack'.

label: Security
definition: Security, privacy and compliance: SOC 2 / ISO / GDPR / HIPAA badges, encryption, enterprise-grade trust claims.

label: Pricing
definition: Plans and prices: pricing tiers/cards, monthly/yearly toggles, plan feature comparison tables.

label: Comparison
definition: Compares the product against competitors or the old way: 'Us vs them' tables, before/after, check vs cross columns. (Plan-vs-plan tables are pricing.)

label: FAQ
definition: Frequently asked questions, usually as an accordion or Q&A list.

label: Call to action
definition: A closing call-to-action band: short headline + button(s) (or a signup field) near the end of the page, before the footer. Not the first section.

label: Newsletter
definition: A standalone email-capture / subscribe section (not part of the footer).

label: Blog & resources
definition: Lists content: blog posts, articles, guides, news, changelog, events, webinars, docs links as cards.

label: Team
definition: People behind the company: team member photos/cards, founders, investors, advisors.

label: Careers
definition: Hiring: open roles lists, 'Join us', benefits, culture for recruiting.

label: Contact
definition: Contact or demo request: contact forms, 'Book a demo' forms, sales contact details, office locations.

label: About & mission
definition: Company story, mission statement, manifesto, values, 'Why we built this'.

label: Divider
definition: A transitional band with little content between sections: a scrolling marquee, a big statement strip, a decorative image strip, a short banner.

label: Footer
definition: The site footer at the very bottom: link columns, legal/copyright, social icons, sometimes a large wordmark or newsletter field.

label: Navigation
definition: ONLY a navigation/header bar or open mega-menu with no hero content below it. If a hero headline is visible, use hero.

label: Other
definition: Anything that fits none of the above (gallery, map, showcase, app download banner…). Never published as its own page.
